description: This file defines the 'Edit' feature for user entities in the application, including data models, validation, and request handling logic for updating user information.

classes.name: Edit
classes.description: Encapsulates the user editing feature, including data models, command, validator, and handler classes.

classes.name: Edit.UserData
classes.description: Data transfer object for user input data during update operation.

classes.name: Edit.Command
classes.description: Request object containing user data for updating user details.

classes.name: Edit.CommandValidator
classes.description: Validates the command ensuring the user data is not null.

classes.name: Edit.Handler
classes.description: Processes the update request, modifies user data in the database, and returns the updated user envelope.

methods.name: Handle
methods.description: Executes the user update operation, interacting with the database and mapping the entity to the response object.
